exclusions.range_contracts: exclude until exact tie and full-precision settlement semantics are independently verified

primary_endpoint: one-sided 95% cluster-bootstrap lower confidence bound of fee- and displayed-depth-adjusted entry-to-settlement net dollars per contract, clustered by settlement date
promotion_rule: Passing all registered research gates creates a review candidate only. It cannot enable production or orders. Independent reproduction and a separately complete production-readiness review are required before any future human activation decision.
retirement_rule: Retire v1.0.2 without promotion if the registered end time arrives or the 250-candidate budget is reached before every registered gate passes. Any modified rule is a new version.
more_data_rule: Collect only within the fixed 2026-08-14T18:51:33Z through 2026-09-30T23:59:59Z window and until no more than 250 eligible candidates. Do not extend the window, add variants, or change sources under v1.0.2.
falsifier: A non-positive one-sided lower confidence bound, calibration error above 0.02, failed placebo, failed liquidity or latency sensitivity, or fewer than 100 settled eligible candidates at the registered endpoint retires v1.0.2.
